```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the historical prices from the quotes.csv file
quotes = pd.read_csv('quotes.csv')

# Filter the relevant tickers
tickers = ["SPY", "QQQ", "EFA", "EEM", "TLT", "IEF", "GLD", "DBC", "NVDA", "AVGO", "ORLY", "FAST"]
filtered_quotes = quotes[quotes['ticker'].isin(tickers)]

# Pivot the data to have dates as rows and tickers as columns
pivot_data = filtered_quotes.pivot(index='date', columns='ticker', values='close')

# Calculate the daily returns
returns = pivot_data.pct_change().dropna()

# Compute the covariance matrix of the returns
cov_matrix = returns.cov()

# Calculate the weights of the minimum variance portfolio
num_assets = len(tickers)
inv_cov_matrix = np.linalg.inv(cov_matrix)
ones_vector = np.ones(num_assets)
weights = inv_cov_matrix @ ones_vector / (ones_vector.T @ inv_cov_matrix @ ones_vector)

# Normalize the weights to sum to 1
weights = weights / weights.sum()

# Create a dictionary of weights
min_variance_weights = dict(zip(tickers, weights))

# Print the resulting weights
print(min_variance_weights)
```
